The '''Alvorine system''' was a ternary [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Yminis sector/Legends|Yminis sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].
